window-1.title: Piano Keyboard 🎹 — dweet d/35177 by dee-gomma
window-1.blurb: Someone built a whole animated piano in 140 characters of code, and there's a remix button right there — which means you're about six minutes away from a new side quest.

window-2.title: The Mood Board #046 — Brianna Schubert
window-2.blurb: It's one creative person's actual monthly brain-dump — Virgo-season resolutions, the fits she wore in Berlin, jobs, odd little finds — and you'll walk away with three new side quests you didn't ask for.

window-3.title: Spicy Passion Fruit Mocktail (AKA "Mockarita")
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients, but you get to char a jalapeño over open flame for smoky depth — a tiny bit of theatre for a drink that's tart, tropical, and named like it's in on the joke.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: Four people, one apartment, zero fear of colour or clutter — this is the warm, object-stuffed, every-wall-has-a-story energy you keep chasing, and it proves a home can be maximal without ever feeling messy.

window-5.title: Cafe Yasuragi, Millenia Walk
window-5.blurb: Tucked inside Millenia Walk with deep teal walls and tan leather booths, it's a moody little hideout that basically begs you to bring the film camera and shoot a whole persona in the corner booth.
